restaurant_name: พอใจแล็บ คลินิกเทคนิคการแพทย์
text:
My wife and I had a number of labs done here last week.

The owner is an expert phlebotomist. Both of my arms are covered with full-sleeve tattos with very little uninked skin. Typically, I need to ask for a draw from the top of my hands as in the past I've had a lot of labs "hunt" my veins, leading to a lot of bruising and discomfort.

The owner was confident she could do it at the  median cubital vein (inner elbow) - and she could. First try, instant success without any pain two different days in a row. Wish she could do all my future bloodwork!

Results from the lab came quickly, each lab as soon as she had it.

Thank you for taking care of my wife and me. 🙏🏻
